Unexposed intermediate setter bodies, compound fields, general frame ownership, numeric extremes, sprites, VM/core/gameplay and full profile acceptance remain separate obligations. Actual native frame bodies use controlled owned tables and child extents; observable native fallbacks and per-profile diagnostics are tested separately from malformed-pointer refusals.
